raw:
I found no literature, so these rest on general NAS-Bench-201 knowledge. In that benchmark, conv3x3 and conv1x1 are strong, skip_connect helps moderately, avg_pool is mid-range, and `none` is usually harmful. Edge 5 set to `none` cuts edges 1 and 2 off from the output. I have not tested any of them against benchmark data.
